agent_notes: Best lead: Khiyana is described (Hindi Wikipedia user essay + Jatland's Dhatarwal gotra page) as the origin/samadhi village of the Dhatarwal Jat clan's folk deity Nathu Dada (d. VS 1444 / 1387 CE), with a temple there drawing devotees from Rajasthan, Punjab and Haryana and an annual fair; one source says the village itself was founded by Khiyaji, Nathu Dada's second son, which conflicts slightly with Jatland's framing of Khiyana as Nathu's own place of origin — both are community/genealogy sources needing independent verification.
